run_HeadsRateModel: run the HeadsRateModel to infer posterior samples for a Beta-Bernoulli model with observations
run_HeadsRateModelTransformed: run the HeadsRateModelTransformed to infer posterior samples using the analytical conjugate prior
test_beta_bernoulli_conjugate_graph: test that the original and conjugate prior transformed Beta-Bernoulli models produce equal BMG graphs
infer_BMGInference: infer posterior samples using BMGInference with queries, observations, and a sample count
to_dot_BMGInference: generate a DOT graph representation of the probabilistic model using BMGInference.to_dot
